note: Sprite processing removed - sprites should be manually reviewed and placed directly in public/assets/

manualTools.ai:extract: Extract frames from a sprite sheet - npm run ai:extract -- --input <file> --output <dir> --frames <count> --size <WxH>
manualTools.ai:process: Manually process a sprite - npm run ai:process -- --input <file> --output <file> --frames <count> --size <WxH> --crop
manualTools.ai:audio: Process single audio file - npm run ai:audio -- --input <file> --output <file> --type sfx|music
manualTools.ai:audio:batch: Process all audio from this config - npm run ai:audio:batch
